about_the_game:
The little adventure of a lost rabbit wandering through the woods to find the way home.

As night draws near, wonder-working plants and flowers light the path ahead.

Become the gentle wind that guides the rabbit, opening paths along the journey.

Watch over it and help it in this short point-and-click game.

Playtime: 20–30 minutes

Features

  • Simple, click-only controls

  • All plants are hand-drawn on paper

  • Gameplay that uses the traits of flowers and grass to open new paths

  • Rich colors and charming animations

  • Music that feels like stepping onto soft earth

  • A wordless experience told entirely through visuals and sound

Credits

Developed by Komitsu / Cobbles

Animation, Design, Direction - Komitsu

Engineer - Shoto Hayakawa

Beta Engineer - Naoya Ohsugi

Music - Natsumi Nogawa

Sound Design - Asuka Kanezawa

Exhibition

・New Chitose Airport International Animation Festival 2018

・The Overkill Festival 2019

・ICC Kids Program 2021: Tune up and Chime in

・ICC Annual 2022: Life / Likeness

reviews:
“A wondrous picture book for everyone, brimming with the surprises of touch.”
Game Cast

““Wander in Wonder” is a point-and-click game that may at first seem simply kawaii, but gradually shows itself to be deeply poetic.”
poptronics

“This game offers countless joys and discoveries, not limited by playtime. Its world is so wonderful that I find myself thinking: if I ever have a child in the future, I would want them to experience it too.”
IGN Japan
